result.summary: Updates the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper to attach logging connections to contexts via btck_context_options_set_logger and configure minimum log levels per connection rather than globally. A logging connection receives no log messages until attached to a context, establishing the API interface required before per-context log separation is implemented.
result.problem: Every logging connection currently receives all kernel log output process-wide regardless of which context produced it, interleaving logs for applications managing multiple contexts (such as mainnet and signet or multi-context tests). Furthermore, the existing C API provides no way to attach a logging connection to a specific context, which would force breaking API changes and call-site refactors on downstream consumers once per-context routing is introduced.
evidence: PR description: 'An application that opens two chainstates (say mainnet and signet, or a test creating several contexts) gets one interleaved log stream and can't tell which context a line came from.'

PR description: 'Per-connection levels are a small feature, but the main purpose is to change the API now, before more code depends on it: #30342 builds on this to give each context's connection only that context's entries, so code like the above gets separate output per context unchanged.'
result.scope_notes: Only the final commit is unique to this PR; the preceding six commits are inherited from draft dependency #34374.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased on top of #34374 to integrate with struct-based logging rather than string-based callbacks, and updated lifetime rules and abort semantics when connections are destroyed before contexts.
result.card: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel C API to attach logging connections to contexts via context options and configure log levels per connection. Currently, kernel logging connections receive an interleaved, process-wide stream across all contexts, with no mechanism to route context logs individually. This defines the API structure ahead of downstream adoption to enable per-context log isolation in follow-up work. Depends on #34374.

risk.why: Flaws in connection lifetime tracking or logging callback synchronization could cause deadlocks or aborts in external applications embedding libbitcoinkernel.
